$$
\left[
	\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1\end{array}
	\right]
$$

$$
\left[
	\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 2 & -1 & 5 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 7\end{array}
	\right]
$$

$$
\left[
	\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}
	\right]
$$

$$
\left[
	\begin{array}{ccc|c}0 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & 1\end{array}
	\right].
$$

" :question/worked-solution "Remember that an augmented matrix is in row echelon form if its coefficient matrix satisfies the following conditions:

- All the zero rows (rows with only zeros), if any, are placed at the *bottom* of the matrix.

- Each leading entry of a row is in a column *to the right* of the leading entry of the row above it.

With that in mind, let's look at each matrix in turn.

- The first matrix is not in row echelon form since $a_{32} \neq 0$ (condition II is violated).

$$
\left[
	\begin{array}{ccc|c}\bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{1} & 2 & -1 & 0 \\ {\color{blue}0} & \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{1} & 0 & 1 \\ {\color{blue}0} & {\color{red}1} & 1 & 1\end{array}
	\right]
$$

- The second matrix is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied).

$$
\left[
	\begin{array}{ccc|c}\bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{1} & 2 & -1 & 5 \\ {\color{blue}0} & \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{2} & 0 & -2 \\ {\color{blue}0} & {\color{blue}0} & \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{1} & 7\end{array}
	\right]
$$

- The third matrix is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied).

$$
\left[
	\begin{array}{ccc|c}\bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{1} & 0 & -1 & 4 \\ {\color{blue}0} & \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{1} & 0 & 1 \\ {\color{blue}0} & {\color{blue}0} & {\color{blue}0} & 0\end{array}
	\right]
$$

- The fourth matrix is not in row echelon form since, for example, the leading entry $a_{22}$ lies to the left of the leading entry $a_{13}$ (condition II is violated).

$$
\left[
	\begin{array}{ccc|c}0 & 0 & \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{1} & 1 \\ 0 & \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{{\color{red}1}} & {\color{black}0} & 1 \\ \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{{\color{red}1}} & {\color{red}1} & {\color{red}1} & 1\end{array}
	\right]
$$
